Five weeks after The Indian Express investigation revealed objections raised by Election Commissioners Sukhbir Singh Sandhu and Vivek Joshi, the Election Commission of India has removed the controversial SIR declaration from the online Form 6. The move follows concerns raised by the two Commissioners that the change was unauthorised and required a legal amendment. This marks another reversal by the Commission on decisions previously challenged by them.
Reported by Ritika Chopra
